insight: Grew out of the open-source GPT Researcher project; AI-infra firm Nebius acquired it for $275M in 2026.
name: Tavily
tagline: Web search API built for LLM agents and RAG pipelines.
description: Search-as-a-tool for LLM agents — returns scrape-friendly results tuned for retrieval rather than ranking. Native integrations across LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and the major agent surfaces.
edge: Returns clean, scrape-ready content instead of ranked links — the default search tool baked into agent frameworks.
cons: Less control than raw web scraping
